newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas shrs end mixed, broadly flat in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Caracas shrs end mixed, broadly flat in slow trade.

text.p: Share prices on the Caracas Stock Exchange edged slightly higher in mixed, slow trade with interest concentrated in less liquid stocks, brokers said.
According to preliminary figures from the exchange, the market's 19-share index edged up 0.22 percent to 9,293.71, as 16 stocks fell, 16 rose and seven closed flat.
Brokers said the low volume of trades were concentrated in less fashionable stocks such as Corimon, H.L. Boulton and Envasaes Venezolanos which have all posted encouraging financial results recently.
Paint company Corimon moved more than 60 percent of the day's share volume of 56.7 million shares. Total trade volume was 5.216 billion bolivars ($10.5 million).
Corimon closed flat at 16.05 bolivars, holding company H.L. Boulton slipped 0.75 bolivars to 55.00 bolivars and bottling company Envases Venezolanos fell 0.75 bolivars to 32.00 bolivars.
Among leading stocks benchmark Electricidad de Caracas rose 3.05 bolivars to 813.10 bolivars and telephone company CANTV rose 5.00 bolivars to 3,025.00 bolivars.
